'''Tree Vikkilynn''' was the headquarters of the [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild]] which was situated in the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] settlement of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had its military storm it in order to claim the records of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes but discovered that all the information had been purged with copies of it being scattered amongst a dozen Guild members for safekeeping.
